perks.name: Gunslinger Proficiency IV

perks.name: Let's Rock

perks.name: Stay On Target

perks.name: Targets Acquired
perks.description: When you have full stacks of <Bold>Stay On Target</>, your ability <Bold>Cooldown</> is reduced by <Bold_UIFriendly>30%</>.

perks.name: Targets Engaged

perks.name: Particle Pulse
perks.description: <Bold>Charges</> a concentrated burst of energy that deals damage proportional to the <Bold>charge</> amount. A full <Bold>charge</> releases a shockwave at the impact site that damages surrounding targets.

perks.name: Disrupting Radiation

perks.name: Particle Overdrive

perks.name: Widened Aperture
